genius.notes: SALVUS SAS has an official French MiCA/EMT authorization recorded in the MiCA field, but that EU authorization is not a GENIUS approval. Schuman's public GENIUS references discuss the U.S. framework at a general policy level; no token-specific U.S. approval, official application, state qualification, or OCC foreign-issuer registration was found. Because the GENIUS framework remains in proposed-rules phase, the conservative status is no-public-authorization-found.
